title: status line classifiers — a tool call that mentions waiting is shown as waiting

AC1.note: utils/status-format.ts exports all five; channel/status.ts imports them and defines none. isPermissionPrompt delegates to utils/permission-prompt.ts, shared with the watchdog

AC2.note: all four demonstrated misclassifications asserted with their corrected phases

AC3.note: the watchdog's own dialog fixture classifies as waiting; the contract test also records that after tmux-monitor parsing it does NOT reach detectPhase at all — the gap this flow documents

AC4.note: every phase covered plus null for empty and whitespace

AC5.note: getSpinnerIcon takes now; stale, exact-threshold and wrap-past-end all tested

AC6.note: plain, k, M, comma grouping, case-insensitivity, singular, no-space suffix, rejections, and the multi-dot defect pinned with a comment naming it as deferred

AC7.note: determinism, difference on differing input, empty string, multi-byte text, hex output

AC8.note: bun run typecheck clean; bun run lint 0 errors (209 warnings, pre-existing); 601 unit tests pass, none skipped or removed

AC9.note: keryx health run: coverage 17.83% (was 17.72% at flow start), gate WARN on coverage only

AC10.note: PR #41 records the narrowing; the WAITING_PREFIX attempt was reverted and the remaining gap — no reachable waiting signal for a real prompt — is documented at channel/permissions.ts and carried to the next flow
